hero.imageAlt: NOMU Zürich interior with rattan pendant lights, olive tree and warm beige tones
hero.title: Private Events at NOMU
hero.subtitle: Your special occasion, our beautiful space.

metaDescription: Host your next birthday, corporate event, baby shower, or brand activation at NOMU Zurich. Exclusive venue hire, custom menus, and dedicated staff in our beautiful space.

pitch.heading: A space for every occasion
pitch.body: Whether you're celebrating a milestone, hosting a team off-site, or launching something new — NOMU offers a warm, intimate setting that makes every event feel special.
pitch.capacityNote: Capacity: approximately 40 guests seated, up to 60 standing.
pitch.extraNote: Food & drink packages available for every budget. Flexible duration — morning, afternoon, or full evening.

eventTypes.title: Birthdays
eventTypes.description: Toast another trip around the sun with friends, matcha cocktails, and our all-day brunch spread.

eventTypes.title: Corporate Events
eventTypes.description: Team lunches, client dinners, or workshops in a calm setting with great coffee and food.

eventTypes.title: Baby Showers
eventTypes.description: A cozy daytime celebration with beautiful tablescapes, fresh smoothies, and sweet treats.

eventTypes.title: Brand Activations
eventTypes.description: Showcase your brand in a photogenic space that's already styled with the NOMU aesthetic.

items.title: Exclusive Venue Hire
items.description: The entire café is yours for the duration of your event — no shared space, no interruptions.

items.title: Custom Food & Drink Menu
items.description: We'll work with you to design a menu that fits your event — from grazing tables to plated brunch, matcha cocktails to specialty coffee.

items.title: Setup & Cleanup
items.description: Arrive to a beautifully prepared space and leave the tidying to us. Tables, florals, place settings — we handle it all.

items.title: Dedicated Staff
items.description: Friendly, professional service throughout your event so you and your guests can relax and enjoy.

pricing.label: Price on request
pricing.body: Every event is different — we'll put together a tailored quote based on your date, guest count, and menu choices. No hidden fees, no surprise charges.

inquiry.heading: Let's plan your event
inquiry.body: Fill out the form below and we'll get back to you within 24 hours with availability and a personalised quote.
